sessions.title: Plan a community workshop
sessions.suggestion: Turn our workshop idea into a practical 90-minute agenda.

messages.content: We are planning a fictional community repair workshop for 12 beginners. We have 90 minutes and a budget of 120 euros for consumables. We should avoid mains electricity and power tools.

We can focus on simple textile repairs and a guided repair assessment. Let’s divide the session between a short introduction, a hands-on activity, and time to share results. What should participants leave with?
Each person should leave with a repaired item and a short checklist they can use at home.

sessions.title: Continue a remembered project
sessions.suggestion: What did we decide about the observatory project?

messages.content: For our fictional neighborhood observatory project, we decided to borrow equipment before buying anything. The first event should focus on the Moon and include an indoor cloudy-weather activity.
That gives us a small first event: borrowed equipment, lunar observing when skies allow, and an indoor Moon-mapping activity as a fallback.
